messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] How do I compute multi-column weighted average using dplyr?
parts:
more exactly,
df %>% summarise_each(funs(weighted.mean(.,weight_column_name)),vars=names(df)[-weight_column_number])

but note that the simpler, more basic "apply" function, works about 10 times faster than the dplyr option.

On Mon, Feb 15, 2016 at 7:19 AM, Ariel Telpaz <ariel...@gmail.com> wrote:
library(dplyr)
df %>% summarise_each(funs(mean))
